tools.name: lab.compare
tools.description: Compute frozen comparisons, bounded objective vectors, complete four-arm factorial effects/interactions, or normal-build promotion decisions.

tools.name: lab.discover
tools.description: Discover bounded local targets, capabilities, profiles, and registered scenarios.

tools.name: lab.run
tools.description: Start granted capture, scenario, individual-operation timing, confirmation, export, or deletion jobs; compare retained quantiles, analyze sampled stacks, recover artifacts, or maintain the catalog; poll, cancel, or stop by operation ID.

tools.name: lab.query
tools.description: Query retained metrics, individual-latency slices, sampled hotspots/method evidence, run windows, GC/suspensions, counter series and time windows, history, verified exports, availability, and bounded artifact slices.

tools.name: lab.inspect
tools.description: Read retained records and artifact manifests. Unqualified native inspection is explicitly unsupported.

tools.name: lab.experiment
tools.description: Maintain hypotheses, baselines/aliases, frozen plans including individual-observation quantile designs, verified observation datasets, registered builds, candidate metadata, work items, and decisions.
